title: Trust Tasks framework — reusable JSON Schema definitions
description: Reusable $defs cross-referenced by individual Trust Task specifications. Not itself a Trust Task specification — the `_framework` directory is skipped by the registry build (folders starting with `_` are not discovered) and by the codegen (which only triggers on payload.schema.json). See SPEC.md §4.5.1 for the normative description of `ext`.

Ext.title: Ext
Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
